title: Rajaraja Chola - Dawn at the Great Temple, 1010 CE
prompt: Cinematic historical documentary shot. Dawn in Thanjavur, South India, in the year 1010. A regal Tamil king in his fifties with deep brown skin, a neatly trimmed grey-streaked moustache and long dark hair tied in a top knot, bare-chested, wearing heavy layered gold necklaces, gold armlets and earrings, and a white silk veshti with a wide gold border, walks slowly and proudly barefoot across a vast sunlit granite courtyard toward an enormous newly completed granite temple tower that rises in carved tiers into a golden sky. The camera tracks behind him at shoulder height, then slowly cranes up to reveal the full height of the tower. Temple priests in white cloth with sacred ash lines on their foreheads bow on either side. Brass oil lamps flicker, thin morning mist, a flock of birds crosses the tower. Photorealistic, shot on ARRI Alexa with a 35mm anamorphic lens, natural skin texture and pores, real fabric movement, warm golden-hour light, shallow depth of field, film grain. Sound: deep temple bells, distant nadaswaram music, birdsong, footsteps on stone. No text, no subtitles, no captions, no watermark.
